items.english: Animals can return some nutrients through compost made from manure. Fresh manure can carry harmful germs. Compost manure fully before using it around food crops.
items.draft: Izilwanyana zinokubuyisela ezinye izondlo ngomgquba owenziwe ngobulongwe. Ubulongwe obutsha bunokuba neentsholongwane eziyingozi. Vundisa ubulongwe ngokupheleleyo ngaphambi kokuba ubusebenzise kufuphi nezityalo zokutya.
items.backtranslation: Animals can return some nutrients through compost made from manure. Fresh manure can have dangerous germs. Rot the manure completely before you use it near food crops.
items.problem: Safety instruction 'compost manure fully' became 'vundisa' (let it rot), losing the compost step; glossary term is umgquba.
items.corrected: Izilwanyana zinokubuyisela ezinye izondlo ngomgquba owenziwe ngobulongwe. Ubulongwe obutsha bunokuba neentsholongwane eziyingozi. Yenza umgquba ngobulongwe ngokupheleleyo ngaphambi kokuba usebenzise kufuphi nezityalo zokutya.
